versions.changelog:
Initial release of Base Buds mint skill.

- Enables minting of Base Bud NFT from an agent-only collection on Base mainnet.
- Requires solving a challenge, payment of 1 USDC (via x402), and an EVM wallet with at least 0.001 ETH.
- Guides users through a four-step mint process: challenge, prepare & sign payment, complete, and broadcast.
- Emphasizes local signing—private keys never leave the user’s environment.
- Supports up to 20 mints per wallet with a 6,000 NFT total supply.
